note: Superior NF rustic campground in a birch stand at the end of FR 354, on Kawishiwi Lake at the edge of the BWCAW, and a BWCAW entry point: the lake is inside the wilderness (no motors; a day-use or overnight permit is needed to go on the water). The sites are pull-in rather than RV-designed but all are over 21 ft; space for one vehicle plus one towed vehicle a site. No trash pickup (pack out). Gradual shore at the campground for swimming. --Claude
